title: Ines and the Harvest
author: Zephyrine Brightwater
blurb: Wendell Halloran, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
